note: Five test pieces chosen to stress v1: an L-shaped sectional, a dining set (chairs that tuck under a table), a queen bed, a wide desk and a tall bookcase. Dimensions are the manufacturer's (IKEA US product pages, Measurements section), converted from inches; `listing` keeps the page's wording. Photos are not committed: `image_url` is the page's gallery image, downloaded by hand into data/ when a 3D model is needed.
